decisions.reason: The product shows quantified savings and remains on the website, so the firm's commitment and public visibility make dropping unlikely.
It is close to the established offer and continues to have a dedicated page, so there is no disappointing evidence to trigger de-escalation.
As a publicly presented flagship product line with positive customer results, the firm is strongly committed and would justify continued investment.
Launched only in 2024 as a product line with its own page, it benefits from escalation of commitment and lacks negative results to justify withdrawal.
Launched in 2024 as a product line and presented on its own page, the firm's sunk investments and public commitment support persistence despite a limited track record.
